source_configuration_delta: Two runtime files; matching recovery renderer and immutable-source root/commit authority only. Preserve role commands, environment, flags, credentials, budgets and stable paths.

staging_bounds.note: Do not perform a full repository checkout or copy databases. Exact candidate sparse checkout under a new immutable authority path only after separate authorization.

steps: Immediately reverify this exact candidate, installed preimages, matched ACTIVE pair, coherent OPEN gate, budget/spending invariants, disk reserve and custody/journal health.

Stage exact candidate sparse immutable source, two runtime replacements, candidate renderer, and all three preimages plus frozen runtime-plan/configuration rollback references. Preserve ownership and permissions. No schema/flag changes.

Reach accepted idle boundary for listener and Walkback: no affected-role RPC in flight and no running Walkback claim. Preserve current journals/custody/held requests; never clear an ambiguous reservation.

Using accepted Supervisor control, stop only listener and Walkback. Prove both previous owners exited. Recheck durable work and reservation ownership; HOLD if safe retirement cannot be established. Resolver stays running and unchanged.

Atomically install the two approved runtime files and bind recovery authority to the exact candidate immutable root/commit. Verify all hashes and both candidate recovery pins before starting either affected role.
Verify ACTIVE generation, shared gate/accounting, unchanged commands/flags/credentials and candidate-aware recovery/fallback. No gate reset or source/schema mixing.

Start listener and Walkback only. Verify exact process authority and unchanged resolver PID. Let existing admission-driven reserve maintenance perform at most20 verified transfers at the492 threshold; do not invoke replay/reset or force protected work.

Observe at least five minutes of natural activity. Verify typed ownership-entry deferrals, attempt preservation, no unowned dispatch, natural births/migrations, verified transfer/reusable slots, custody consistency, no recoverable-refusal crashes, reservations, disk and file/WAL safety. Report unobserved events honestly.
rollback: On critical acceptance failure, quiesce only affected roles and coherently restore the exact two installed runtime preimages, old renderer and source-authority plan preimage. No database/journal rollback. Preserve every durable admission, protected record, accounting charge and held request. Revalidate pair/gate and source pins; never select terminal/deferred/gate-unaware fallback.
